Greeting: Hello. I can help with general exercise, hydration, diet, cooling, and warning-symptom guidance related to heat stress recovery.
Exercise Guidance: Return to exercise gradually after heat stress. Start with lower intensity activity, monitor symptoms, and avoid training in high heat until fully recovered.
Hydration Guidance: Focus on restoring hydration after heat exposure. Replace fluids lost through sweat and consider electrolytes when sweat losses are high.
Diet and Recovery Nutrition: Recovery nutrition should support energy replacement, especially carbohydrates, along with regular meals and fluids.
Cooling Strategies: Cooling strategies may include resting in a cool environment, cold fluids, ice slurries, cooling towels, or other practical cooling methods.
Warning Symptoms: If symptoms include confusion, fainting, collapse, seizure, severe dizziness, or altered consciousness, stop activity and seek urgent medical help.
